title: Install Claude Code and give it a first task

steps.title: What we'll do today
steps.html:
This practice uses the terminal (the black text window). If you're new, we recommend starting with Desktop 1, which only needs button clicks.

We'll install an AI assistant called Claude Code on your computer and give it its first job.

  • Time: 20–30 minutes
  • You need: a computer (Windows or Mac), internet, and a payment card for a paid plan
Tip — Open this page on your phone and follow along on your computer. On your phone, just go to: earlln.com/lab.html

Don't worry about unfamiliar words. We explain each one the first time it comes up.

faq.a: An AI assistant you give jobs to in plain words. Ask it something like "tidy up this file" and it creates and edits files for you.
Yes. Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan (Pro or higher) billed monthly. You'll see the exact price when you sign up. A free account can't use it.
This practice needs a computer. Phone and tablet practices are coming soon.

steps.title: Which computer will you install Claude Code on?
steps.html: Pick the computer you'll install it on, not necessarily the device you're reading this on.

choices.label: I'm not sure
choices.sub: We'll show you how to check

steps.title: How to tell Windows from Mac
steps.html:
Look at the computer's keyboard.

  • A ⊞ (window) key at the bottom left → Windows
  • A ⌘ command key → Mac

An apple logo on the back or lid also means it's a Mac.
steps.button: Got it, let me choose again

steps.title: This practice needs a computer
steps.html:
Claude Code is a program you install on a computer. Practices for phones and tablets are coming soon.

Come back when you have a home or work computer. Your progress is saved in this browser.

steps.title: Do you have a Claude account?
steps.html: Claude Code needs a paid Claude account (Pro or higher).

choices.label: I only have a free account

steps.title: Sign up for Claude
steps.html:
First, open a browser on your computer. A browser is the program you use to look at the internet. Click one of these icons at the bottom of your screen:

  • Windows: Microsoft Edge (blue wave) or Chrome (red, yellow and green circle)
  • Mac: Safari (compass) or Chrome
  1. Click the address bar at the very top of the browser, type claude.ai and press Enter.
  2. Choose Continue with Google, or sign up with your email address.
  3. If you used email, open the confirmation email in your inbox and click its button.

check.q: Did you finish signing up and see the Claude chat screen?

faq.a: It's the long box at the very top of the browser where you can type. It usually shows an address starting with https://. Click it once and the text turns blue; then just type claude.ai.
It's the big key on the right side of the keyboard, marked Enter or ↵. On a Mac it may say return.

steps.title: If signing up doesn't work
steps.html:
• If the confirmation email doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.
  • If you have a Google account, Continue with Google is the easiest.
  • If it asks for your country, pick the one you live in.

steps.title: Subscribe to a paid plan (Pro)
steps.html:
1. On claude.ai, find and click the Upgrade button or menu.
  2. Choose the Pro plan. (Max also works, but Pro is plenty to start.)
  3. Enter your card details and pay.
Check the payment yourself — read the price and whether it renews every month before you continue. You can cancel any time.

check.noLabel: I can't find the Upgrade button

steps.title: Finding the Upgrade menu
steps.html:
The screen layout changes from time to time. Check these places:

  • The menu that opens when you click your name (or your initial in a circle) at the bottom left
  • The word Upgrade near the top or near the chat box

Still can't find it? Ask Claude in the chat box: "Where do I upgrade my plan?" It will tell you.

steps.title: How to tell if your account is paid
steps.html:
Go to claude.ai in your browser.

  • If you see a sign-in screen → sign in if you have an account, or choose I don't have an account.
  • If you see Pro or Max near your name at the bottom left → it's paid.
  • If an Upgrade button stands out → it's probably free.
steps.button: Got it, let me choose again

steps.title: Get a Claude window ready for your questions
steps.html:
If you get stuck during the practice, you can ask Claude directly. Let's try it once now.

  1. Tap I have a question below to open it.
  2. Type What is Claude Code? and press Ask Claude.
  3. A new window (or the Claude app) opens. Check the chat box:
    · If your question is already there → press Enter
    · If it's empty → click the box once, paste, then press Enter
What is pasting? — It puts in the text you copied. On a computer press {{paste}} together; on a phone, press and hold the box, then tap Paste.

When you've seen the answer, come back here. You can ask like this any time you get stuck.

steps.title: If asking Claude doesn't work
steps.html:
• If no new window opens, go to claude.ai in your browser and type your question in the chat box. It's the same thing.
  • If you see a sign-in screen, sign in with your account.
  • This step is just practice, so it's fine to move on even if it doesn't work.

choices.label: Skip for now
choices.sub: I'll ask on claude.ai if I get stuck

steps.title: Name your practice folder
steps.html:
Claude Code works inside one folder that you choose. To start, it's safest to practice in an empty folder.

Choose a folder name. If you're not sure, just keep Practice.

steps.title: Make a '{{folder}}' folder on your desktop

win.html:
The desktop is the background screen you see when the computer starts. If windows are open, click — (minimize) at their top right to tuck them away.

  1. Put your mouse on an empty spot of the desktop and click the right mouse button.
  2. In the menu, click New → Folder.
  3. When the name box turns blue, type {{folder}} and press Enter.

mac.html:
The desktop is the background screen you see when the computer starts.

  1. Right-click an empty spot on the desktop.
    On a Mac trackpad, press with two fingers together to right-click.
  2. Click New Folder in the menu.
  3. While the new folder's name (untitled folder) is selected, type {{folder}} and press return.

check.q: Is there a '{{folder}}' folder on your desktop now?

faq.a: Click the folder once, then press <kbd>F2</kbd> on Windows or <kbd>return</kbd> on a Mac to type the name again.

steps.title: If making the folder doesn't work

win.html:
• If you don't see New in the menu, right-click a completely empty spot, not on an icon.
  • If you can't see the desktop, press ⊞+D together to tuck all windows away.

mac.html:
• If no menu appears, hold the control key and click the desktop. That's also a right-click.
  • Or click the desktop once, then choose File → New Folder from the menu at the very top of the screen.

win.title: Open the text command window (PowerShell)
win.html:
You install Claude Code in a window called PowerShell. PowerShell is a window where you give the computer commands by typing instead of clicking. It may look scary, but today you only paste and press Enter.

  1. Press the ⊞ key at the bottom left of the keyboard once.
  2. Type powershell.
  3. Click Windows PowerShell in the list.
win.alt: Typing powershell in Windows search and clicking Windows PowerShell

check.q: Did a blue (or black) window open?

mac.title: Open the text command window (Terminal)
mac.html:
You install Claude Code in a window called Terminal. Terminal is a window where you give the computer commands by typing instead of clicking. It may look scary, but today you only paste and press return.

  1. Press ⌘ command and space (the longest key) together.
  2. When the search box appears in the middle, type Terminal and press return.
mac.alt: Typing Terminal in the Mac search box

check.q: Did a white (or black) text window open?

win.html:
• Check the spelling: powershell. If your keyboard is set to another language, switch it to English first.
  • If you see Terminal in the list instead of Windows PowerShell, that's fine. Click it.

mac.html: • If the search box doesn't appear, click the magnifying glass at the top right of the screen.

win.html:
1. Press Copy on the box below. (If you're reading this on your phone, open this page on your computer to copy it, or type it exactly.)
  2. Click the PowerShell window once.
  3. Press {{paste}} together to paste.
  4. Press Enter.
win.alt: The install command pasted into PowerShell

mac.html:
1. Press Copy on the box below. (If you're reading this on your phone, open this page on your computer to copy it, or type it exactly.)
  2. Click the Terminal window once.
  3. Press {{paste}} together to paste.
  4. Press return.
mac.codeLabel: Command to paste on a Mac

check.q: Did text scroll by for a while and then stop?

faq.q: Can I paste on my computer what I copied on my phone?
faq.a: Not directly, since they're different devices. Open earlln.com/lab.html in your computer's browser and copy it there. Progress is saved separately on each device.
It downloads and runs the installer from the official address (claude.ai) of Anthropic, the company that makes Claude. It's the same as in the official install guide.

win.html:
• If nothing happened: make sure you pressed Enter after pasting. If pasting didn't work, click the right mouse button once inside the window to paste.
  • If red text appeared: close the window and start again from opening it. If it's the same, copy the red text and ask Claude, "I got this error."
  • Work computers may block installs for security. In that case, ask your IT team.

mac.html:
• If nothing happened: make sure you pressed return after pasting.
  • If it asks for a password: type the password you use to log in to your Mac and press return. It's normal that nothing shows while you type.
  • If an error appeared: copy that text and ask Claude, "I got this error."

win.html:
Well done. Now close the PowerShell window by clicking ✕ at the top right.

Right after installing, you need to open a new window for it to find Claude Code.

mac.html:
Well done. Now close the Terminal window by clicking the red circle at the top left.

Right after installing, you need to open a new window for it to find Claude Code.

steps.title: Open the text window in the '{{folder}}' folder

win.html:
Claude Code works inside the folder where you open the window. So we open it inside the '{{folder}}' folder.

  1. Double-click the {{folder}} folder on your desktop to open it.
  2. Click the address bar at the top of the folder window (the long box showing the folder path) once.
  3. When its text turns blue, type powershell and press Enter.
win.alt: Typing powershell in the folder address bar

mac.html:
Claude Code works inside the folder where you open the window. So we point Terminal at the '{{folder}}' folder.

  1. Open Terminal again. (⌘ command+space → Terminal → return)
  2. Type cd and press space once.
  3. Drag the {{folder}} folder from your desktop and drop it onto the Terminal window. The folder path fills in by itself.
  4. Press return.
mac.alt: Typing cd in Terminal and dragging the folder in

steps.title: If opening the window in the folder doesn't work

win.html:
• When you click the address bar, all its text should turn blue. Try clicking once more.
  • Check the spelling of powershell.
  • Still stuck? Open PowerShell the normal way (previous step), type cd and a space, drag the {{folder}} folder onto the window, and press Enter. Same result.

mac.html:
• You must put one space after cd.
  • Drop the folder inside the Terminal window.
  • If you see "no such file", start again from the top.

steps.title: Start Claude Code
steps.html: Type the text below in the window and press {{enterkey}}.

win.html: Type the text below in the window yourself and press Enter. (It's short, so typing is fine.)

mac.html: Type the text below in the window yourself and press return. (It's short, so typing is fine.)

check.q: Did you see an English welcome like 'Welcome to Claude Code', or a question?

steps.title: If Claude Code doesn't start
steps.html:
• If you see 'claude' is not recognized (Mac: command not found): close all windows and open them again. If it's the same, restart the computer and do this step again.
  • If it still doesn't work, go back to the install step and install again. (Press '← Back' a few times.)
  • You can also copy the text you see and ask Claude.

steps.title: First time only — sign in
steps.html: The first time, it asks a few questions. Don't worry. Use the arrow keys ↑↓ to choose and just press {{enterkey}}.

win.html:
The first time, it asks a few questions. Don't worry. Use the arrow keys ↑↓ to choose and just press Enter.

  1. Asked to pick a color theme → just press Enter
  2. Asked for a login method → press Enter on 1. Claude account with subscription
  3. When a browser opens by itself → sign in, click Authorize, then come back to the original window.
  4. Asked whether you trust this folder → press Enter on Yes

mac.html:
The first time, it asks a few questions. Don't worry. Use the arrow keys ↑↓ to choose and just press return.

  1. Asked to pick a color theme → just press return
  2. Asked for a login method → press return on 1. Claude account with subscription
  3. When a browser opens by itself → sign in, click Authorize, then come back to the original window.
  4. Asked whether you trust this folder → press return on Yes

steps.alt: Choosing option 1 for the login method

check.q: Are the questions done, and do you see a box to type in (with a > sign)?

faq.a: The order and wording change a little between versions. If you're not sure, just press Enter. The first option (at the top) is usually right. For the login method, though, make sure you pick Claude account (your subscription).

steps.title: If signing in doesn't work
steps.html:
• If no browser opens, select the long address (https://…) shown in the window with your mouse, copy it, and paste it into your browser's address bar.
  • Check that you have a paid (Pro or higher) plan. Free accounts can't sign in.
  • When you come back to the window after signing in, it may ask you to continue. Press Enter.

steps.title: Give it a first task
steps.html: Now give Claude a job in plain words. Paste or type the sentence below into the box and press Enter (return on a Mac).
steps.code: Create a file called todo.txt and write 3 example to-dos for today

steps.title: "May I create it?" — give permission
steps.html:
Claude always asks first before creating a file. When you see Do you want to create todo.txt?, it means "May I create todo.txt?"

With 1. Yes selected, press Enter (return on a Mac).

Don't choose option 2 (Yes, allow all…) for now. It means "don't ask me again, just do everything". We'll cover it later, once you're comfortable.
steps.alt: Choosing Yes when asked whether to create the file

steps.title: If the permission question doesn't appear
steps.html:
• Claude may still be thinking. Wait a few seconds.
  • If Claude asks you something back, type your answer and press Enter.
  • If it already says it created the file, go to the next step and check the folder.

steps.title: See the result with your own eyes

win.html:
Look at the {{folder}} folder window on your desktop. (If you closed it, double-click it to open it again.)

Double-click the todo.txt file. Notepad opens and shows the to-dos Claude wrote.

mac.html:
Double-click the {{folder}} folder on your desktop to open it.

Double-click the todo.txt file. TextEdit opens and shows the to-dos Claude wrote.

steps.alt: todo.txt has appeared in the folder

check.q: Do you see todo.txt in the '{{folder}}' folder?

steps.title: If you can't see the file
steps.html:
• Check that you opened the Claude window in the {{folder}} folder. If you opened it somewhere else, the file may be there.
  • Ask in the Claude window: "Where did you create todo.txt?" It will tell you the location.
  • Closing and reopening the folder window sometimes helps.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.html:
That's it for today. To close Claude Code:

  • Type /exit in the box and press Enter (return on a Mac), or
  • just close the window.

Next time, start from opening the window in the '{{folder}}' folder → typing claude. You don't need to install or sign in again.

steps.title: 🎉 First practice done! What you learned
steps.html:
You made it all the way. Here's a short recap of what you did.

Youask in wordsClaude Codewith permissionFile done

New words

BrowserThe program you use to look at the internet (Edge, Chrome, Safari)
PowerShell · TerminalA window where you give the computer commands by typing. PowerShell on Windows, Terminal on a Mac
CommandThe text you type in that window. Today you used the install command and claude
InstallPutting a program on your computer. You only do it once
Claude CodeAn AI assistant that works inside that text window. Just ask in plain words

Two things to remember

  1. Claude Code works inside the folder where you open the window. That's why we opened it in the practice folder. Open it in the folder you want it to work on.
  2. It always asks before creating or changing anything. Things only change when you read and press Yes, so you can use it with peace of mind.

Next step

In the next practice you'll have it edit today's todo.txt and learn to read what it's about to change.
